summary_en: This study tests DSP-0390 taken together with atezolizumab as maintenance treatment for extensive stage small cell lung cancer that has not progressed after first-line chemoimmunotherapy. DSP-0390 is taken by mouth once a day in 21-day cycles at 180 mg, 120 mg, or a determined safe dose, and atezolizumab is given per standard of care (FDA-approved dose 1200 mg IV every three weeks), until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity, for up to 2 years. The study evaluates safety and preliminary efficacy, and it is a Phase 1 study (a Phase Ib pilot with a safety lead-in).
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa DSP-0390 administrado junto con atezolizumab como tratamiento de mantenimiento para el cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa que no ha progresado después de la quimioinmunoterapia de primera línea. DSP-0390 se toma por vía oral una vez al día en ciclos de 21 días, a 180 mg, 120 mg o una dosis segura determinada, y atezolizumab se administra según el estándar de atención (dosis aprobada por la FDA de 1200 mg por vía intravenosa cada tres semanas), hasta la progresión de la enfermedad o toxicidad inaceptable, por un máximo de 2 años. El estudio evalúa la seguridad y la eficacia preliminar, y es un estudio de Fase 1 (un piloto de Fase Ib con una fase inicial de seguridad).
who_for: Extensive stage disease that has not progressed after 3-4 cycles of first-line platinum-based chemoimmunotherapy.
At least 18 years old with ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Adequate blood counts, liver function, and kidney function as defined in the criteria.
not_for: Prior or current cancer that could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Investigational agents within 4 weeks before Day 1 (6 weeks for investigational immunotherapy).
Untreated symptomatic brain metastases or clinically evident CNS hemorrhage.
Conditions that significantly limit oral drug absorption, such as short-gut syndrome, or an abnormal ECG or history of Torsade de Pointes.
cancer_types: extensive stage small cell lung cancer
